column1: # THE deploy target table for k8s-oke. One file, read by every job in
# .github/workflows/deploy.oke-manifests.yml that needs to know what lives
# under deploy/oke/.
# It used to be two hand-maintained copies inside that workflow - a heredoc in
# the render job and a TABLE in the apply job - which the workflow's own
# comment forbade in the same breath ("Silent divergence between two copies of
# the same truth is the exact bug this workflow exists to close, so it does not
# get to have one"). It had one. This is that fix.
# EVERY entry under deploy/oke/ must appear here, deployable or not. The render
# job fails on an unregistered entry, so a new directory or script is a PR-time
# error with a clear message rather than a red deploy on main after the merge.
# That is not hypothetical: adding unreferenced-configmaps.py (#100) and then
# tests/ (#101) broke the apply on main both times, and because the planner
# fails BEFORE it applies anything, main sat with an unapplied
# revisionHistoryLimit change - shipped, green PR, not live - until someone
# read the deploy log.
# columns: name  mode  flag  path
#   auto      applied on push to main when its files changed, AND on every
#             scheduled reconcile whether anything changed or not (#38).
#   dispatch  NEVER applied by a push, and NEVER by the schedule.
#             zippie-clienthome is dispatch-only because its committed
#             `zippie-clienthome-clients` ConfigMap is a PLACEHOLDER
#             (`clients.json: []`). Auto-applying it would overwrite live
#             pairing state with an empty list the first time anyone touched
#             that directory - and the schedule would do it again every six
#             hours. Apply it deliberately, via workflow_dispatch with
#             target=zippie-clienthome, once it has a Secret instead of a
#             placeholder.
#   none      NOT deployable, and never will be. Registering an entry here is
#             as deliberate an act as adding a target: it is the difference
#             between "this is tooling" and "somebody forgot to wire this up",
#             which is precisely what the planner cannot infer on its own.
# `flag` and `path` are unused for mode=none and are written as `-`.
zippie-home                 auto      -k  deploy/oke/zippie-home
zippie-hub                  auto      -k  deploy/oke/zippie-hub
zippie-clienthome           dispatch  -f  deploy/oke/zippie-clienthome/zippie-clienthome.yaml
targets.tsv                 none      -   -
tests                       none      -   -
unreferenced-configmaps.py  none      -   -
reconcile_cadence.py        none      -   -
